# Isaias Santos

> Full Stack Developer specializing in Next.js, TypeScript, and Contentful headless CMS.

Isaias Santos is a full stack developer who designs and builds content-driven
web applications. His work focuses on the JavaScript ecosystem: Next.js and
React on the frontend, Node.js services on the backend, GraphQL APIs, and
headless CMS architectures with Contentful, deployed to AWS. This site is his
portfolio and a living example of that stack: a Next.js App Router application
whose pages, sections, and components are fully managed in Contentful, so new
landing pages can be created and updated without code changes.

## About this site

The site is deliberately built as a demonstration of the practices Isaias
works with:

- **Next.js (App Router)** for server rendering, per-page metadata, and
  strong Core Web Vitals.
- **Contentful** as the single source of content: pages are composed of
  sections and components modeled in the CMS and fetched over GraphQL.
- **AWS Amplify** for low-cost hosting and continuous deployment.
- Semantic HTML, JSON-LD structured data, a sitemap, and a robots policy
  that explicitly welcomes both traditional and AI search crawlers.
